newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices remained mostly steady Friday, capping a week of slow activity, dealers said.
"It is very quiet," a North Carolina dealer said. "I think everything is booked. Not much is going on."
But he noted soft red winter wheat was being used in ingredients instead of midds. They (feedmixers) are still buying a lot of wheat," he said.
One Kansas City dealer said there was starting to be some dry pasture spots in Texas and Oklahoma from recent high temperatures.
But that still has not picked up the demand for millfeeds, he said.
So long term, that is bullish, another dealer said. "Conversely we have hot weather which is bearish for feed business, " he said, referring to livestock being off feed due to high temperatures.
He said he expected the market to be trading sideways for the next 30 days with some fluctuations.
"There are pockets of good business and pockets of bad business. It almost changes on a daily basis," he said.
In North Texas, nearby demand has increased and supplies remained tight, a Texas dealer said.
